# CPL0 system instructions at CPL3 (ledger U801-U829): the i5-13600K (Windows, CPL3) vs Unicorn
# with the strict i5-13600K CPUID profile and cpl=3. Generated by Emulator/tools/isa/ref_sysins.py
# (--write, do not edit):
#   emu-alltest --cases Emulator\data\cases_sysins_hw.txt --cpuid Emulator\data\cpuid_i5-13600k.txt
# WRMSRNS (U801): CPUID.(07H,1):EAX[19] = 0 on this CPU -> #UD on both
.byte 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1B01 rax=0x1 cpl=3
.byte 0x48, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0xE1 cpl=3
# RDMSRLIST / WRMSRLIST (U802): CPUID.(07H,1):EAX[27] = 0 on this CPU -> #UD on both
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1 m+0x8000=2F00000000000000 cpl=3
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x01, 0xc6 | rcx=0x1 m+0x8000=2F00000000000000 cpl=3
# RDMSR / WRMSRNS imm32 (U803): no MSR_IMM (VEX map 7) and no APX (EVEX) on this CPU -> #UD on both
.byte 0xc4, 0xe7, 0x7b, 0xf6, 0xc0, 0x2f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 | r9=0x1 cpl=3
.byte 0xc4, 0xc7, 0x7a, 0xf6, 0xc1, 0x01, 0x1b, 0x00, 0x00 | r9=0x1 cpl=3
.byte 0x62, 0xf7, 0x7f, 0x08, 0xf6, 0xc0, 0x2f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 | r9=0x1 cpl=3
.byte 0x62, 0xd7, 0x7e, 0x08, 0xf6, 0xc1, 0x01, 0x1b, 0x00, 0x00 | r9=0x1 cpl=3
# HRESET (U804): CPUID.(07H,1):EAX[22] = 0 in the profile, so the SDM gives #UD; the i5-13600K
# decodes it and raises #GP(0) at CPL3 (docs/quirks.md "HRESET without CPUID"). Other ModRM
# bytes are #UD on both.
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x3a, 0xf0, 0xc0, 0x00 | rax=0x0 cpl=3 # known deviation: HRESET without CPUID
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x3a, 0xf0, 0xc0, 0x00 | rax=0x1 cpl=3 # known deviation: HRESET without CPUID
.byte 0xf3, 0x0f, 0x3a, 0xf0, 0xc1, 0x00 | rax=0x0 cpl=3
# LKGS (U805): CPUID.(07H,1):EAX[18] = 0 on this CPU (and CPL3) -> #UD on both
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x00, 0xf1 | rcx=0x2B cpl=3
.byte 0xf2, 0x0f, 0x00, 0x76, 0x40 | m+0x8040=2B00 cpl=3
# INVPCID (U806): the i5-13600K has INVPCID (CPUID.(07H,0):EBX[10] = 1): #GP(0) at CPL3 on both,
# also with an invalid type or descriptor (CPL is checked first); register form #UD
.byte 0x66, 0x0f, 0x38, 0x82, 0x46, 0x10 | rax=0x2 m+0x8010=00000000000000000000000000000000 cpl=3
.byte 0x66, 0x0f, 0x38, 0x82, 0x46, 0x10 | rax=0x9 m+0x8010=FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF0000000000800000 cpl=3
.byte 0x66, 0x0f, 0x38, 0x82, 0xc6 | rax=0x2 cpl=3
